offering_description.value: ONE Gas sells natural gas to households, businesses and public institutions through its regulated utilities. It operates local pipelines that deliver gas it purchases and transport gas that some large customers buy from other suppliers.

primary_services.value: local natural gas delivery; transportation of customer-owned natural gas

customer_segment.value: B2C: households; B2B: commercial businesses, industrial facilities and wholesale gas buyers; B2G: public authorities and government facilities

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial buildings; industrial energy; public facilities; wholesale natural gas

revenue_model.value: product sales: natural gas sold to utility customers at regulated rates; transaction or usage fees: metered delivery of gas customers purchase from other suppliers; service fees: fixed monthly utility customer charges
revenue_model.category: product sales; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates local pipelines and meters that deliver gas to homes, businesses and public facilities; distributor: buys gas from suppliers and resells it to utility customers; service provider: transports customer-owned gas for commercial and industrial users

geography_served.value: US regional: Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas

specialization.value: niche specialist: regulated natural gas distribution and transportation through local utility networks

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: local utilities deliver gas directly to customers through company-operated pipelines and meters

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state utility commissions and Texas municipalities regulate gas rates, and state and federal authorities oversee pipeline safety
